philo-of-alexandria.oneLineEn: Interpreted Torah with Greek categories; key starting point of ancient Jewish philosophy.

pierre-bayle.oneLineEn: Historical and Critical Dictionary influenced Leibniz via skepticism, tolerance, and theodicy.

poincare.oneLineEn: Conventionalism and scientific method; after mathematical foundations and Duhem.

rabia-al-adawiyya.oneLineEn: Early Sufi saint whose pure divine love—not for paradise or hell—became classic source of Sufi love.

ranciere.oneLineEn: Distribution of the sensible and political aesthetics; after Althusser.

ravaisson.oneLineEn: Of Habit influenced Bergson and linked French spiritualism to classical metaphysics via Aristotle.

raymond-aron.oneLineEn: Liberal political philosophy and philosophy of history; after Weber and against Sartre.

rene-girard.oneLineEn: Mimetic desire and the scapegoat mechanism.

renouvier.oneLineEn: Neo-criticism rewrote Kant and influenced William James on free will.

rg-collingwood.oneLineEn: Philosophy of history and question-and-answer logic; fills Anglo-American historical epistemology.

richard-swinburne.oneLineEn: Probabilistic theology and philosophy of religion; fills contemporary Anglo-American natural theology.

risieri-frondizi.oneLineEn: Argentine value theorist whose structure of value and self entered Latin American academic philosophy.

rm-hare.oneLineEn: Prescriptivism in normative ethics; transition between metaethics and applied ethics.

robert-brandom.oneLineEn: Inferentialist semantics; Pittsburgh school after Sellars.

rodolfo-kusch.oneLineEn: Argentine thinker critiquing European ontology via American presence, Indigenous worlds, and popular culture.

ruan-ji.oneLineEn: Wei-Jin xuanxue figure known for personal freedom, critique of ritual law, and Zhuangzi reception.
keywordsEn: Seven Sages of the Bamboo Grove

rumi.oneLineEn: Persian Sufi poet-mystic whose Mathnawī made love, union, and soul transformation poetic philosophy.

ruth-barcan-marcus.oneLineEn: Pioneer of quantified modal logic; modal-semantic background before Kripke.

sakya-pandita.oneLineEn: Sakya systematizer who advanced Tibetan pramāṇa in Treasury of Reasoning.

salazar-bondy.oneLineEn: Peruvian philosopher who opened the classic debate with Zea on Latin American philosophical authenticity.
keywordsEn: Is There a Philosophy of Our America?
